decisions.reason: Reusing colors and content on the Ridgehaven and main sites does not change the requirement to keep the Harbor Valley site live or its master-site linkage.
The source specifies content and visual reuse targets but does not change SEO preservation or migration handling.
The existing state already requires the Shatter House colors, logo, and consistent branding across the master and location sites; the source does not establish a distinct change.
Content, colors, style, and logo reuse do not alter location-specific booking placement or isolation.
The source does not change separate revenue, sales, analytics, or reporting operations.
Applying reused content and visual branding to the main site does not change its location selector, listed locations, or routing behavior.

The phrase "with the style they have" could refer to the competitor website, the existing Shatter House sites, or the mockup, so it cannot safely produce a propagated MODIFY for the unresolved design-reference requirement.
The source addresses visual and content reuse only and does not change separate payout accounts or payment setup.
Shared content and branding do not alter the requirement for separate location customer databases.
The source does not change Ridgehaven's separate gift-card operations.
The source does not change the operational separation of Ridgehaven memberships.
Calling the target the new main site does not specify a new domain or change the established master-domain mapping.
